senses.sense_definition: A large circular stone used in pairs for grinding grain or corn into flour.

examples.text: The old watermill still uses a heavy <w>millstone</w> to grind grain into flour.
Visitors could see how the heavy <w>millstone</w> turned slowly against the bottom stone.

senses.sense_definition: A heavy burden, problem, or responsibility that is difficult to endure or escape.

examples.text: The massive debt became a <w>millstone</w> around his neck for many years.
Her unfinished doctoral dissertation was a constant <w>millstone</w> weighing on her mind.

senses.sense_definition: A coarse-grained type of sandstone suitable for making grinding stones; millstone grit.

examples.text: Quarry workers extracted blocks of rough <w>millstone</w> to supply local masons.
The cliffs were composed mostly of hard <w>millstone</w> layered between soft shale.
